18.t: Working with data: IVF success and age
q: State the success rate for women under 35.
Calculate how many times more successful IVF is under 35 than at 40-42.
Suggest why success falls with age.
Older women have fewer eggs and more eggs with chromosome errors, so fewer embryos develop normally.
A clinic advertises "1 in 3 succeed". Evaluate this claim for a 41-year-old patient.
Misleading for her: 1 in 3 fits only under 35. At 40-42 it is about 1 in 9 per cycle. Clinics should give age-specific figures.
